preconditions.description: n, k, and x are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a is within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output array b has the same length as the input array a.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i % x == a_i % x for b_i, a_i in zip(b, a))
postconditions.description: Each element in b has the same remainder when divided by x as the corresponding element in a.

postconditions.expression: product(b) <= product(a) if k > 0 else product(b) == product(a)
postconditions.description: The product of elements in b is less than or equal to the product of elements in a, unless no operations are performed.
